messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: DETECTED TLS handshake failure spike for prod-gateway. Elevated 5xx rates (502/525) and client TLS errors since 2026-03-14T23:59:49Z. Threshold: 8% error rate over 5m. Please respond.

Jordan (oncall): I'm on it — joining. Observing errors across eu-west and us-central. Putting page on loud. Sam, Lee, Anya — pls ack.

Lee (sre): Ack. Looking at gateway metrics now. Top-level symptom: SSL/TLS handshake failures, connection resets from clients.

Sam (eng-runtime): I'm checking edge-proxy logs. Seeing a flood of: `TLS alert handshake failure` and upstream errors 525. Early guess: cert chain issue or mTLS mismatch.

Anya (netops): I'm running a quick cert check against the gateway from a probe host. Output:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood.ai:443 -showcerts -servername gateway.prod.redwood.ai
---
depth=2 O = Example CA, CN = Example Root CA
depth=1 C = US, O = Example Intermediate, CN = Example Intermediate CA
depth=0 CN = *.redwood.ai
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
verify return:1
---
SSL handshake has read 3121 bytes and written 456 bytes
Verify return code: 10 (certificate has expired)
```
That `certificate has expired` looks authoritative. Timestamp on cert: expired 2026-03-14 23:53 UTC.

Jordan (oncall): Oof. That explains client rejects. Does the chain include a now-expired intermediate or the leaf?

Anya (netops): Intermediate appears expired. The leaf shows valid dates, but the intermediate expired yesterday. Our LB was using a combined chain bundle with that intermediate.

Sam (eng-runtime): Confirmed in proxy logs: vendor TLS stack rejects chain with expired intermediate. We have fallback chain configured but not currently active.

Lee (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) flip to backup cert chain on load balancer 2) restart edge-proxy pods gradually if needed 3) reissue chain from CA 4) postmortem and automation fix.

Maria (customer-success): Heads-up: CS liaising with top impacted customers. Preparing templated message: "We are investigating TLS handshake errors affecting some requests; we will update within 30 minutes."

Jordan (oncall): Proceed with mitigation 1. Anya — can you switch LB to backup chain? If not, Sam/Lee you'll trigger rolling restart and patch secrets.

Anya (netops): I have access to the LB console. Switching to backup chain now (will roll over to HA backup bundle).

deploy-bot: action: lb-cert-switch started by Anya (netops) at 2026-03-15T00:03:12Z — target: gateway-prod, cert-bundle: backup-chain-2026-02-15.

Anya (netops): Switch complete. Checking health.

Sam (eng-runtime): Starting canary restart of edge-proxy-prod (1/10 pods) to pick up any cached chain changes.

ops-sre: Observability alert: handshake-failure-rate dropped from 12% -> 6% after LB switch. Continuing to monitor.

Jordan (oncall): Good sign. Keep monitoring for 10m. Maria, please update customers with that we have applied a temporary fallback and are working on reissuing a fresh intermediate.

Maria (customer-success): Update posted to impacted tenants and CS queue. ETA 30 minutes for full remediation.

Lee (sre): Initiating cert reissue with CA now. Also creating a rotated combined bundle and testing in staging.

Sam (eng-runtime): Patch secret and rollout plan prepared: `kubectl -n prod patch secret tls-gateway --patch "{\"data\":{\"tls.crt\":\"<new-bundle-base64>\"}}"` then rolling restart deployment/edge-proxy-prod with `kubectl rollout restart`.

deploy-bot: rollout triggered by Sam (eng-runtime) for deployment edge-proxy-prod at 2026-03-15T00:14:05Z.

ops-sre: Observability: error rate returned to baseline (~0.9%) by 2026-03-15T00:18:30Z. Latency stable.

Jordan (oncall): Confirmed baseline. Root cause preliminary: expired intermediate CA in deployed chain bundle — our cert rotation automation skipped intermediate refresh due to parsing bug.

Anya (netops): CA handed over new intermediate bundle and we rotated to it. Automation fix: patching ACME/rotation script to validate intermediate expiry and to fallback to backup bundle automatically.

Lee (sre): I'll own postmortem and runbook updates. Action items:
- postmortem with timeline + customer impact (Lee)
- fix rotation script + unit tests (Sam/Anya)
- add synthetic monitor for intermediate expiry (Jordan)
- tighten alerting to include percent of TLS verify errors (ops-sre)
- CS follow-ups for top 10 customers (Maria)

Jordan (oncall): Handoff to Lee for long-form postmortem. My on-call shift done in 10m. Short summary for handoff: temporary LB fallback applied -> rolling restart -> CA reissue complete -> baseline restored.

Lee (sre): Taking over. I'll open the postmortem doc and fill in first pass. Please drop logs and timestamps here.

Maria (customer-success): CS updated customers with mitigation and next steps. Will send follow-up once postmortem is available.

Jordan (oncall): Thanks team. Incident mitigated at 2026-03-15T00:18:30Z. Filing incident ticket and linking to postmortem once ready. :white_check_mark:

Lee (sre): Noted. Adding incident tag and scheduling blameless review. Thanks everyone for quick response.

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging on-call at 2026-03-15T00:25:50Z by Jordan (oncall).
